title: How Long Do You Keep Your Door Open?
summary: An episode debating where our responsibility toward the stranger comes from and where it ends; ranging from desert hospitality to Levinas's concept of the face, from Kant's right of hospitality to Derrida's unconditional hospitality, and on to the ethics of the guest in the Islamic-Turkish tradition, it takes up whether opening the door is a courtesy or an obligation.
